urls.rationale: Act 472 of 1978 (Lobbyists, Lobbying Agents, and Lobbying Activities, MCL 4.411-4.431) is Michigan's Lobby Registration Act — registration, expenditure reports, and gift/contact disclosure all live here.

notes: Only one in-scope act in Chapter 4. Act 214 of 1947 (Legislative Agents, 4.401-4.410) is marked Repealed in the snapshot. Definitions and penalties are within Act 472 itself, so no support-chapter pick is needed.
